dict.string: Alfred workflow for Beeper Desktop - Search messages, send messages, and manage chats across all messaging networks

# Alfred runs scripts with a minimal PATH that excludes Homebrew, nvm, fnm and # Volta, so a bare `node` fails with "command not found". Resolve it explicitly. export PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH"
NODE_BIN="$(command -v node 2>/dev/null)"
if [ -z "$NODE_BIN" ]; then for candidate in \ "$HOME/.volta/bin/node" \ "$HOME/.fnm/aliases/default/bin/node" \ "$HOME/.nvm/alias/default/bin/node" \ "$HOME/.local/share/fnm/aliases/default/bin/node"; do if [ -x "$candidate" ]; then NODE_BIN="$candidate"; break; fi done fi
# nvm installs are versioned; take the highest version present if [ -z "$NODE_BIN" ] && [ -d "$HOME/.nvm/versions/node" ]; then NODE_BIN="$(ls -1 "$HOME/.nvm/versions/node" 2>/dev/null | sort -V | tail -1)" [ -n "$NODE_BIN" ] && NODE_BIN="$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/$NODE_BIN/bin/node" [ -x "$NODE_BIN" ] || NODE_BIN="" fi
if [ -z "$NODE_BIN" ]; then printf '%s\n' '{"items":[{"title":"Node.js not found","subtitle":"Install Node 20+ (e.g. brew install node), then try again","valid":false}]}' exit 0 fi
# Route based on first argument if [ -z "$1" ]; then # No argument - show menu "$NODE_BIN" src/index.js menu else # Has argument - parse subcommand cmd=$(echo "$1" | awk '{print $1}') args=$(echo "$1" | cut -d' ' -f2-)
case "$cmd" in search|send|contact|unread|recent|setup) if [ "$cmd" = "$args" ]; then "$NODE_BIN" src/index.js "$cmd" else "$NODE_BIN" src/index.js "$cmd" "$args" fi ;; *) "$NODE_BIN" src/index.js menu "$1" ;; esac fi

NODE_BIN="$(command -v node 2>/dev/null)"
if [ -z "$NODE_BIN" ]; then for candidate in \ "$HOME/.volta/bin/node" \ "$HOME/.fnm/aliases/default/bin/node" \ "$HOME/.nvm/alias/default/bin/node" \ "$HOME/.local/share/fnm/aliases/default/bin/node"; do if [ -x "$candidate" ]; then NODE_BIN="$candidate"; break; fi done fi
# nvm installs are versioned; take the highest version present if [ -z "$NODE_BIN" ] && [ -d "$HOME/.nvm/versions/node" ]; then NODE_BIN="$(ls -1 "$HOME/.nvm/versions/node" 2>/dev/null | sort -V | tail -1)" [ -n "$NODE_BIN" ] && NODE_BIN="$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/$NODE_BIN/bin/node" [ -x "$NODE_BIN" ] || NODE_BIN="" fi
if [ -z "$NODE_BIN" ]; then echo "Node.js not found. Install Node 20+ (e.g. brew install node)." >&2 exit 1 fi
# Pass the raw pipe-delimited string to Node.js # Node.js will handle the splitting "$NODE_BIN" src/index.js action-raw "$1"

# Beeper for Alfred
Quick access to all your messages across WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal, Slack, and more—right from Alfred.
## Quick Start
1. **Enable API in Beeper Desktop:** - Open Beeper Desktop → Settings (⌘,) → Developers - Toggle "Beeper Desktop API" to ON - Copy your Access Token
2. **Configure Workflow:** - Type `bp setup` in Alfred - Follow the setup instructions - Paste your access token when prompted
## Commands
### Main Menu Type `bp` or `beeper` to see all available commands.
### Search Messages `bp search <query>` - Search across all networks - ↵ Open message in Beeper - ⌘↵ Copy message text - ⌥↵ Quick reply
### Send Message `bp send` - Send message to any contact 1. Type contact name 2. Select contact 3. Type message and press ↵
### Unread Inbox `bp unread` - View all unread messages - ↵ Open chat - ⌘↵ Quick reply - ⌥↵ Archive chat
### Recent Chats `bp recent` - Quick access to last 10 chats
## Network Filters Add `:network` to filter by platform: - `bp search:whatsapp dinner` - `bp unread:telegram`
## Troubleshooting
**"Could not connect to Beeper Desktop API"** → Ensure Beeper Desktop is running and API is enabled
**"Invalid access token"** → Run `bp setup` to reconfigure
For more help, visit: https://github.com/deletosh/beeper-alfred
